name: Stochastic Pop (Bernstein/Steckler) with ADX range and stoch bias
author: Jake Bernstein / David Steckler (via StockCharts)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Stochastic(14) and Stochastic(70), ADX(14), 250-day volume average, Parabolic SAR
entry_long: Bias bullish when 70-period daily Stochastic > 50 (Steckler: weekly 14 Stoch > 50 and rising); ADX(14) < 20 (prefer <15) shows range; buy when 14-day Stochastic surges above 80 on above-average volume (volume > 250-day average volume).
entry_short: Mirror ("Stochastic Drop"): bearish bias, ADX low, 14-day Stochastic plunges below 20 on high volume.
exit: Trail with Parabolic SAR; momentum shift exit when 14-day Stochastic falls below 50 (take profit/tighten stop).
stop_loss: Just below consolidation support or the reaction low before the pop.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Stop is discretionary (support/low) and can be coded as lowest low of pre-pop swing.
